description: Payment of compensation for damages caused to the paddy cultivation due to the construction of a salinity barrier across the Nilwala River in Matara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-07-07, has granted approval for the payment of compensation for the damages caused to paddy cultivation in the Matara District during the 7 consecutive seasons from the Yala season 2019 up to the Yala season 2022 due to the flood situation caused by the obstruction of the Nilwala River during the construction of the salinity barrier across the Nilwala River, getting the provisions allocated through the budget after conducting a proper assessment on the same. Accordingly, the amount of compensation has been calculated taking into account the cost and paddy price as per the compensation payment methods of the Agricultural and Agrarian Insurance Board, and an amount of Rs. 1,200 million has been allocated through the Budget 2026, for the payment of the relevant compensation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to pay compensation to the farmers who are eligible to receive compensation as follows, was approved by the Cabinet.
